newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy firms, corn and wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy firms, corn and wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers rose one to two cents a bushel while corn was mostly steady, export sources said. Wheat values were flat.

Dealers said harsh winter conditions hampered movement. The National Weather Service said winds of 45-50 miles per hour were causing blizzard conditions in eastern South Dakota, southwestern Minnesota and northwest Iowa. Wind chills were expected to drop to 50-70 degrees below zero (F) Thursday night.
In export news, South Korea's Cheijedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills bought 21,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
Also, U.S. vegetable oil dealers said China this week bought between 20,000 and 30,000 tonnes of South American soybean oil for January and February shipment.
